newsitem.title: USA: No merger for Knoxville and Knox County, Tenn..
newsitem.headline: No merger for Knoxville and Knox County, Tenn..

text.p: Voters in Knoxville and Knox County, Tenn., decided not to merge their governments, an official in the Knox County election office said Wednesday.

Although the results did not include 40,000 absentee ballots, voters defeated the proposal by a 54 percent margin. The no votes totled 70,114 while the yes votes totaled 59,321, the election official said.
Voters turned thumbs down on the proposal that officials had projected would save $9 million to $10 million.
